reason: E2 directly supports that columnar boundaries are oxygen diffusion paths and that a random grain orientation yields the best oxidation resistance. However, neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence that multi-arc ion plating parameters can be adjusted to achieve a random grain orientation, nor do they explicitly link random orientation to a denser Cr2O3 layer.
premises: Columnar grain boundaries in Cr coatings provide fast oxygen diffusion paths at high temperature.
A Cr coating with relatively random grain orientation exhibits the best oxidation resistance.
Multi-arc ion plating parameters can be adjusted to change grain orientation from columnar to random.
A denser, more protective Cr2O3 layer forms on coatings with random grain orientation.
